#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/appdata-storage/appdata-lvm.img
dev=$(losetup -j "$image" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')

  dev=$(losetup --find --show "$image")

if command -v lvmdevices >/dev/null 2>&1; then

fi
pvscan --cache "$dev" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay appvg >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' "$dev" > /run/appdata-loop.device
